name: xbox-starcraft
description: A fan-made, StarCraft-style **first-person shooter** for **personal use**. You're a marine in a powered suit holding a night landing zone against waves of zerglings (and worse). Original code — all art is procedural primitives, all audio is synthesized. Not affiliated with Blizzard.

scripts.deploy: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp index.html style.css dist/ && cp -R js dist/ && wrangler deploy
